prompts.name: mood_happy
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite for GEPREK!, a warm Indonesian ayam-geprek warung game. Create ONE isolated customer-expression speech-bubble icon on a genuinely transparent PNG alpha background. Square composition designed on a 128 x 128 pixel logical grid, clear 1-2 logical pixel dark warm-brown outline, crisp pixel clusters, limited warm palette (cream #F4DDA7, toasted tan #BD874D, deep brown #39271F, chili red #C9472D). Match detailed top-down cozy kitchen pixel sprites with dark outlines, wood and cream accents; readable when displayed at only 28 pixels. Bubble is cream parchment with subtly shaded tan lower edge, rounded-square body and one small tail pointing straight down. Symmetric consistent silhouette fills about 85 percent of the canvas, generous transparent border. Facial marks are large and simple dark-brown pixel shapes. No text, no letters, no watermark, no scene, no checkerboard painted into background, no extra floating objects. Render as pixel art, not vector, not smooth gradients. Expression: satisfied, cheerful closed crescent eyes and one broad happy smile, two tiny muted coral cheek dots.
